descriptionChirho: Spatial adverb/preposition indicating position or direction above, on top of, or over something; the primary locative sense. Multilingual evidence: spa sobre/encima, arb فَوْقَ (fawqa, 'above'), kor 위에 (wi-e, 'on top'), swa juu ya ('on top of'), hin ऊपर (upar, 'above'). Used both as a true adverb and as a preposition governing a genitive noun.

Comparative use meaning 'more than' or 'in excess of' a specified number or amount, functioning as a quantitative intensifier rather than a spatial locative. Multilingual evidence confirms the distinct meaning: spa por más de / por encima de, arb لِأكثَرَ مِن (li-akthara min, 'for more than'), kor 이상 (isang, 'or more') / 보다 더 (boda deo, 'more than'), swa zaidi ya ('more than'), hin से अधिक (se adhik, 'more than').
